evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep says: 'This should take me about five to ten minutes or so and then I'll get you an accurate estimate. Does that sound good?' — framing present but time estimate is 5–10 minutes (script calls for 10–15) and rep rushes past the yes without a real wait.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Rep asks: 'Do you have any specific concerns or any important questions you want answers during this call today?' — asked before logistics probing begins. Customer responds: 'I mean just really I guess the biggest thing is well and you know, aren't insured bonded all of that and then you obviously prices of factor too but.' Rep does not follow up with 'tell me more about that' or dig deeper.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raises two concerns (insurance/bonding and price). Rep acknowledges but never asks a follow-up question to probe either concern. Rep pivots immediately to address collection ('I can answer all of that for you in a little bit') without any 'tell me more' exploration.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: No reflection back to the customer. Rep does not summarize: 'So what I'm hearing is [insurance/bonding concerns] and [pricing] — did I get that right?'
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Rep gathers: property type (2BR apartment), floor (4th level), rooms (two bedrooms implied, multiple furniture items), walking distance/elevator access, special considerations (elevator situation, driveway/alleyway parking at destination), additional stops (none). Nearly all seven items covered.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Rep asks: 'Do you need help packing or are you guys planning on having everything boxed up?' — packing services explicitly offered.
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Rep asks: 'For the boxes that we're, we are going to be moving, do you have an idea of how many that would be like a rough number?' Customer responds: 'I am gonna say... I'll just take forty.' Rep confirms and anchors against typical range: 'usually for apartments this size we see around thirty to forty boxes.'
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Rep provides range and personalizes: 'Usually for a move this size it usually takes anywhere from four to six hours. So I would just budget on the higher end based on the inventory plus the number of boxes and like the twenty minute drive. For example, if it only took us like four hours the cost is $872, in case it takes us six hours it's gonna be $1,308.'
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Rep explains hourly rate structure ($218/hour Friday, $204/hour M–Th for two movers + one truck), explicitly states 'we do not have any additional fees, you know, we don't have anything like a fuel fee, no disassemble reassembly fees, no hidden keys of any type at all,' describes 2.5-hour minimum and 15-minute prorating. Both components present.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Rep never asks 'Does that feel fair?' or equivalent. Call moves directly to customer saying 'I'm gonna look at all the numbers and then I'm gonna try to make a decision before the end of the day.'
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: Not mentioned at all. No reference to on-time guarantee, discount terms, or starting to discount immediately if late.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: Not mentioned at all. No reference to No Worries Damage Coverage, $2,000 coverage, no-deductible framing, or inclusion in rate.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: Rep does not return to the initial concerns (insurance/bonding and price) to confirm they've been answered. Two Promises section does not exist on this call; no closing confirmation asked.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Rep never asks 'What's still concerning you about this move?' or any variant. Call ends with customer saying they'll decide and call back.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Rep never asks 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' or equivalent catch-all.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Rep never asks 'Would you like our help with your move?' or any direct booking request. Customer volunteers to call back after reviewing numbers; rep does not push or ask for the business directly.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: Not mentioned. No reference to rate locking or deposit terms.

top_strength: Jules gathered comprehensive logistics details (property type, floor, elevator access, parking, furniture inventory, box count, destination address and layout) that would support accurate quoting and crew prep.
coaching_note: Complete Section 2 by following up two layers deep on the customer's stated concerns (insurance/bonding and pricing) before moving to logistics, and skip Sections 5, 6, and 7 entirely—no Two Promises, no final concerns check, and no explicit ask for the business, leaving the call incomplete and the sale unasked.
